about_the_game:
Arkham is not, by any means, considered a dangerous place - at least that’s what the citizens seem to think. The police, though, knows there is much more to the city and the cases they encounter can not always be solved by logic and reason.

Detective Claude Rowland has neither the experience nor enthusiasm – his job with the Arkham police is merely a way to pay the bills. But when his close colleague, James, commits suicide during an investigation into a mysterious series of deaths in the city, it seems like more than just a routine case. Something is wrong; all these deaths are too similar. What truths did James uncover that led him to such an end? After being assigned to the case, Claude vows to uncover the truth, no matter the cost. 

Nothing is as it seems

Inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft and classic adventure novels, Cthulu Mysteries: The Veins of Arkham tells a story where every solved crime is another unpredictable, disturbing puzzle piece. The case, portrayed in a unique, paintery visual style, won’t be an easy one.

Dive into the eerie atmosphere of the city and abandon your beliefs as the story you’re about to encounter defies anything you have ever known. What happened to the victims? Why does each clue uncover countless dreadful revelations? The madness is pulling you in and it is up to you whether you let it devour you. 

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

Investigate crime scenes

Search locations to find previously undiscovered clues. Learn more about the victims and the secrets they were hiding. Solve puzzles, collect evidence, and uncover the truth.

Take notes

A detective’s trademark is a handy notebook. Gather key information, take notes, compare, and connect conclusions. If your mind isn’t clear, at least your notes will be.

Question witnesses

Meet a lively cast of characters ready to help you, but only if you play your cards right. Learn more about the victims' lives and their everyday behaviour. Everything they say might turn out to be useful.

Explore the city

Forget about modern GPS – if you want to reach a location, you’ll have to find your way. Use key information to discover new places in the city and mark them on your map.

Listen to your inner voice

Understanding certain truths and developing new leads requires a moment of inspiration. When you’re stuck in the investigation, take a moment to reflect. You’ll figure it out.

Use your wits

Analyze the clues and search for the links that will help you uncover the truth. Deduction is an important skill of every great detective in history, and you want to leave your mark.

Keep your sanity

Sometimes, the truth is beyond comprehension. Can Claude handle it? Even if it’s something the human mind can’t grasp, even if it makes you want to stop digging, you must stay focused. Don’t let it consume you, don’t let it drive you mad.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Cthulu Mysteries: The Veins of Arkham is Lovecraftian narrative mystery, where staying sane is the greatest challenge. Interview the witnesses, gather clues and draw conclusions to solve the most unusual case. Will you be able to handle the truth?
